title: Unit Event — Deep Dark for Light — Episode3 Joint Practice?!

meta.Event Outline: On the last day of the workshop, Wonderlands×Showtime learn about the upcoming ArcLand Show Contest, and they decide to compete. Faced with the challenging role of a prince beset by despair, Tsukasa becomes keenly aware of the gap between himself and Asahi.

rows.Line: A few days later
ArcLand - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I know this was on short notice, so thanks again for agreeing to it.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Everyone... We'll be practicing jointly from today on. Let's make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was surprised to hear you'd be entering the contest too, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha! True, you wouldn't expect an ArcLand team to participate in an external-facing contest, huh?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But the higher-ups apparently want this to be an opportunity for ArcLand's younger actors too.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: We've been told to show what we can do on a level playing field with other troupes. No relying on our more experienced coworkers at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That does sound like it'll be a good experience.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah! And we're all excited to go head-to-head with actors and directors around our own age, with only our own skills!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can imagine... It's exciting for me too, and it's bringing out my competitive spirit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's all compete to make the best shows we can!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I hope we can all bring one another to greater heights. That's why I invited you to practice with us, after all.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So let's all do our best! We won't let you beat us, though!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We have no intention of losing, either!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Oh! Wonderlands×Showtime, you came! Good to see you all again!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: I'm so glad we get to practice next to you! We'll be splitting up our programs, but we can stretch and do vocal warm-ups together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah...of course! Thank you for having us once again!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! Let's get stretching!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Right!
Okaaay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The invitation was a surprise... But we're lucky to have this opportunity.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We'll be getting to watch our competitors from ArcLand up close... This ought to make for fine motivation.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll have to put in more effort than ever...!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm just sick of rice balls, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that seems like a good note to end the improv exercises on. Let's split up and start rehearsing, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Understood. Let's say everything from this desk over will be us, and the other half will be you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! Until later, then!
se_walk_men_002_4

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's get right into it. Is everyone ready to start from the opening lines?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go, full power!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have less than two months until the contest. We can't waste a single second.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This may be a joint practice, but what I have to do hasn't changed.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Take everything I've learned in our training, and embody my role fully!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Take my hand, Harte! Let's retire to our paradise of love, just the two of us!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “H-Hey! Blesse?!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this is shaping up well. I especially like how much of the stage you're utilizing, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show is meant to be enjoyable for all ages, so I'd always intended the acting to be somewhat overstated. You're doing exactly what I want you to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... In that case, am I maybe being too subdued?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mm... You're not doing badly, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It might be something to keep in mind. Harte is somewhat withdrawn, so if your performance is too naturalistic, that big stage may swallow you up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're right...
How about something like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm, that still seems a little small.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It might be best to consider me as a reference.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The audience will see both Harte and Blesse on stage. We'll be compared no matter what. So for balance, you'll need to match me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The same applies for the speed of your movement. So move like me, but a little slower... Like this, maybe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see... Thanks, Tsukasa! I'll give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, right, Rui. About this line here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Harte criticizes Blesse and he snaps back at her, right? I've been playing it as a comedic moment and reacting instantly, but... This is an important scene for showing their differing mindsets.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rather than playing up Blesse's shock, I wonder if pausing for a moment might make it more impactful. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I intended this scene to be a lively back-and-forth, but... Could you play it out for me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Nene, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay!
...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “You scoundrel! You absolute, utter cad! You don't care for me at all anymore, do you?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “If you did, you wouldn't say 'later' and 'some other time' so easily!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I could say the same to you! Every time I come to see you, you're nowhere to be found! And you barely reply to my letters anymore!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “W-Well, I...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see it. I was concerned a pause might lose the momentum, but that was very good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really? Then let's go with this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We're making good progress.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The mindset of envisioning the character's life that I learned from Shunmeiza. The power to portray him with my whole body that I developed with Mikazukigumi. And the repertoire of techniques I gained at Morinomiya...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The things I've gained make it easier for me to grasp and play my roles than ever before.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And with the fact that we didn't lose soundly to the ArcLand cast during the workshop...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We are improving, for sure...!
Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahi! What about your practice?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: We just paused for lunch break, actually. And then I saw you all performing an interesting scene.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I have to say, Tsukasa! Your acting is so different now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You're moving differently, for one. You're more poised and focused. You know exactly what you need to do to portray your role.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I don't know if you know him, but I'm reminded of Mr. Kijima from Mikazukigumi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Asahi... You know Mr. Kijima?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, we worked together a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Wait, did you actually train with him?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We spent some time with Mikazukigumi, actually.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I see! That explains why you reminded me of him.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Then... By chance, did you visit Shunmeiza too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We did... But how could you tell?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hahaha, just a feeling. When I saw Tsukasa and Nene getting into character, the way they focused reminded me of Bakuno.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: J-Just from that?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (To think he could tell that much just from a look...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Asahi never fails to impress. It's proof of the breadth of things he's studied and experienced in his life.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait... That's it!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Asahi! This is only if you have the time, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Could I ask you how you, personally, would play my role of Prince Blesse?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh? Hm, I wonder... Can I have a look at the script?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, here!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Thanks! Can I have ten minutes or so?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Thank you for taking the time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've been refining my own approach as best I can through trial and error. But, that scene...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “None of this matters.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“No matter what I do, humanity will still hate.
Countries will still wage war.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No matter how much we wrack our brains, no matter what we try to accomplish... Nothing ever changes.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “It's all meaningless.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's the lowest point in the entire story.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I know I haven't yet reached the true essence of the despair Blesse feels in that moment.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But hearing how Asahi would approach Blesse should be a good reference point for me.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Mhm. It's a little slapdash, but I've got the idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really? Then, if I could ask how you'd approach it...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Sure. Let's see... Um...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Uh... Actually, I don't know if I'd get it across just by telling you...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I played it out real quick?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?
